Owange ggwe Nnabbi lwaki oziza ebyo Allah bye yakukkiriza, nga onoonya okusiimisa bakyala bo. Bulijjo Allah Muyitirivu Wa kusonyiwa era Muyitirivu Wa kusaasira.
Allah yabateerawo engeri gye muva mu birayiro bye muba mukoze, anti bulijjo aba nammwe, ate nga Yye Muyitirivu Wa kumanya, buli ky'akola akikola lwa nsonga.

Era jjukira Nnabbi bwe yabuulira omu ku bakyalabe (Hafuswa) ekyama, omukyala oyo bwe yamala okwogera ekyama ekyo, ate Allah n'akitegeeza Nnabbi. Nnabbi n'amubuulirako ebimu ebirala n'abireka. Nnabbi olwakibuulira omukyala oyo (omukyala n'amubuuza) nti ani yakikugambye (Nnabbi n'amuddamu nti) eyakintegeezezza ye Muyitirivu W'okumanya Omukenkufu (Allah).

Singa munaaba mwenenyezza mwembiriri (Hafuswa ne Aisha) ewa Allah (ky'ekirungi gye muli), anti emitima gyammwe gyawaganyadde. Naye bwe munamwekalakaasizaako, (mumanye nti) mazima Allah ali ku ludda lwe, ne Jibuliiru, n'Abakkiriza abalongoofu, ne Bamalayika bonna oluvannyuma lw'ekyo baakumuyambako.

Singa anaaba abatadde, Allah Omulezi We, ajja kumuwaanyisizaamu abakyala abalala abasinga ku mmwe, nga Basiraamu nnyo, Bakkiriza, nga bagonvu nnyo, nga beenenya era nga basinza nnyo Allah, abatambulira mu kumutya, ka babe nga baafumbirwako oba nga tebafumbirwangako.

Abange mmwe abakkiriza mwewonye muwonye n'abantu bammwe Omuliro, nga gukumirwa ku bantu na mayinja, gukuumibwa Bamalayika abakambwe abaamaanyi ennyo, tebajeemera Allah mu kyonna ky'aba abalagidde, ate nga bakola ekyo kyonna kye baba balagiddwa.
(Ku lunaku lw'Enkomerero abawakanya Allah n'omubaka we baligambibwa nti) Abange mmwe abawakanyi temwetonda olwaleero, mazima mugenda kusasulwa ebyo bye mwakola.

Abange mmwe abakkiriza mwenenyeze Allah olwenenya olwannamaddala. Omulezi wa mmwe Allah kikakafu ajja kubasangulako ebyonoono byammwe era abayingize Ejjana ezikulukutirwamu emigga. Olunaku Allah lw'ataliweebuula Nnabbi n'Abakkiriza abali naye. Ekitangaala kyabwe nga kibeetoolodde mu maaso ne ku ddyo waabwe, nga bagamba nti Ayi Omulezi Waffe tulekerewo ekitangaala kyaffe era otusonyiwe (ebyonoono byaffe) anti mazima Ggwe oli Musobozi ku buli kintu.
Owange Omubaka, lwanyisa Abatakkiriza n'abannaanfuusi era bakambuwalire, obuddo bwabwe Muliro Jahannama, buddo bubi.

Allah yakubira abatakkiriza Allah n'Omubaka We ekifaananyi kya muka Nuuhu ne muka Luutu. Baali bakyala ba baddu ababiri mu baddu Baffe abalongoofu, naye nno ne babakumpanya (n'obutakkiriza Allah). Nnabbi Nuuhu ne Nnabbi Luutu tebaalina kye baagasa bakyala baabwe ewa Allah. Ne bagambwa (Abakyala bombi) nti muyingire Omuliro awamu n'abo abaguyingira.

Era Allah yakubira abakkiriza e kifaananyi kya muka Falaawo mu kiseera we yasabira (Allah) nti: Ayi Omulezi Wange nzimbirayo ennyumba Gy'oli mu Jjana era omponye Falaawo n'ebikolwa bye, omponye n'abantu abeeyisa obubi.

Era Allah yakuba ekifananyi kya Mariyamu muwala wa Imraan oyo eyeekuuma kale ne tufuuwa mu ye omwoyo ogwava Gyetuli era Mariyamu n'akkiriza Ebigambo bya Katonda We n'Ebitabo Bye, n'abeera nga ali mu basinza Allah abagonvu.
